components.Box: A flex container. It stacks its children in a column (direction "row" puts them in a row). Use it to group children with gap, padding, border, radius or background.
components.Column: A vertical flex container. Its default gap already separates sections, so do not add padding, background or a Spacer for space.
components.Row: A horizontal flex container. Label and value pair: justify "spaceBetween", a Caption left and a Text with fontWeight "medium" right. Buttons go in a Row at the bottom of a Card: one variant "primary", the others default or "borderless".
components.Grid: A CSS grid container. On a narrow screen, its columns collapse towards one column.
components.GridItem: A cell of a Grid, with an optional span. A span that covers all rendered columns fills the row.
components.Card: A bordered panel, only for an interactive panel (controls, a form, a configurator); tables, charts and text need none. Give it a Title and a Caption. Separate groups with a Divider or the gap, never a nested Card or bordered Box. Variant "section": no box; "outline": always a box. In markdown mode, without controls it renders as "section" unless variant or border is set.
components.Flow: A masonry-like grid that packs cells of different sizes. Put FlowItem children in it.
components.FlowItem: A cell of a Flow, with an optional span.
components.Carousel: A horizontally scrolling row that snaps to its CarouselItem or CarouselMediaItem children, with arrows. Bind activeIndex to read or set the slide in view.
components.CarouselMediaItem: A Carousel slide: an image with its children (a Caption, a Text) under it. size "sm" 160px, "md" 240px (default), "lg" 320px wide. A click opens all slides full-screen, unless href or onClick is set.
components.Spacer: Flexible empty space. You almost never need it: use the default gap.
components.Divider: A line between two groups: horizontal, or vertical with axis "vertical" in a Row.
components.Tabs: Tabs that show one panel at a time. Each tab has a title and the id of its panel component: "tabs":[{"title":"Specs","child":"specs"}].
components.Title: A heading in a Card or next to another component; a heading alone is markdown. Size "2xl" at most once per surface, "lg" for sections. "sm" is an h4, "md"/"lg" an h3 (default "md"), "xl" and up an h2. Bold unless strong is false.
components.Text: Body text in a Card or next to another component; a paragraph alone is markdown outside the fence. Color "default" or "secondary". `text` takes inline markdown (**bold**, *italic*, ~~strike~~, ++underline++, `code`, [link](url)). `children` ids render inline after it, e.g. a Badge.
components.Caption: Small secondary text: a hint under a control, or a label in a Row. `text` can have inline markdown.
components.Label: The label of a form field.
components.Badge: A small status pill. Use the colors success, danger and warning only to show a status, not for decoration.
components.Blockquote: A block quotation with a line on the left. `text` can have inline markdown.
components.Code: A block of code in a monospace font.
components.Markdown: A block of GitHub-flavored markdown. Use it only next to other components, for example in a table cell or next to a chart. Markdown alone goes outside the fence.
components.Math: A TeX math formula, typeset with KaTeX. Set block to true for a centered formula on its own line.
components.ShimmerText: Text with a moving shimmer. It shows that something is loading or pending.
components.Link: A link. Only http, https and mailto URLs work. It opens in a new tab.
components.Tooltip: Shows `content` when the user points at or focuses `trigger`. `trigger`: one child id, a Text, Icon or Badge (not a Button or Link). `content`: one child id of short text, no links or buttons.
components.Button: Sends its onClick event; with href it opens the URL, with copy it copies the text. Variant "primary" for the one main Button in a Row. submit true submits the Form around it. Its children render instead of the label. With checks it is disabled while a check fails.
components.Pressable: A layout container that the user can click or press with Enter or Space. It sends its onClick event, or opens href. A control inside it sends only its own event.
components.Form: A layout container that is a form. It sends onSubmit when the user submits (a Button with submit true, or Enter in a field). Put its field values in the event context with { "@path": "/x" }.
components.TextField: A text input, single-line unless variant is "longText". Bind value with { "@path": "/x" } to read what the user typed. Give it a label.
components.TextArea: A multi-line text input. Bind value with { "@path": "/x" } to read what the user typed. Give it a label.
components.Select: A dropdown list of options. Bind value with { "@path": "/x" } to read the chosen option. Give it a label.
components.CheckBox: A checkbox with a label. Bind value with { "@path": "/x" } to read its state, true or false.
components.Radio: One radio button. Use RadioGroup instead, because it keeps the chosen value.
components.RadioGroup: A group of radio buttons. The user chooses one option. Bind value with { "@path": "/x" } to read it. Give it a label.
components.Slider: A range slider for a number between min and max. Bind value with { "@path": "/x" } to read the number. Give it a label.
components.SegmentedControl: A row of segments. The user chooses one option. Use it for 2 to 5 short options. Bind value with { "@path": "/x" } to read it.
components.ChoicePicker: Options as checkboxes or chips: pick one, or several with variant "multipleSelection". Its value is the list of chosen values. Give it a label.
components.DateTimeInput: A date picker, a time picker with enableTime, or both. timeStep (minutes) offers fixed times, e.g. 30 for a booking. The value is ISO 8601. Give it a label.
components.PulseIndicator: A small dot that pulses, for example next to the text "Live". Set label when no text next to the dot says what it means.
components.FlashcardFlip: A card that shows the front text. A click or the Enter key flips it to the back text, and again to the front.
components.Popover: A small overlay: exactly two children, one PopoverTrigger then one PopoverContent. A click on the trigger toggles it; Escape or a click outside closes it.
components.PopoverTrigger: The trigger of a Popover. Its children are the label of the trigger: a Text or an Icon. Do not put a Button in it, because the trigger is already a button.
components.PopoverContent: The body of a Popover. It shows only when the Popover is open.
components.Modal: A dialog over the page. A click on the trigger (a Button or a Text) opens the content in the dialog. Escape, the close button or a click on the backdrop closes it.
components.Table: A data table, in a plain Column, not a Card. Give "columns" and "rows", or "children": TableSection or TableRow ids, or a template { "componentId", "path" } repeating a TableRow per item. A component in a cell or header (Badge, Button, Icon, Text): { "componentId": "<id>" }, with the id in "cellComponents".
components.TableSection: A group of TableRow children in a Table. With header true, it is the header of the table.
components.TableRow: A row of a Table. Its children are TableCell ids, or a template. With label, a header cell with that text starts the row.
components.TableCell: A cell of a TableRow. It shows "text", or its children. With header true, it is a header cell.
components.List: A list in a Card or next to another component; a plain list of text is markdown. Give "items": an item with a value and no action is a key-value row (Price: $1,599). Or give "children": ListItem ids or a template. With "action" the user picks an item; the event context gets its index, label and value.
components.ListItem: An item of a List, with a label, a value on the right, a description, an icon and children. With an "action", the user can pick it.
components.Chart: A bar, line, area, scatter, pie or donut chart. "data" is a list of objects. "xKey" is the field of the category. "series" are the value fields.
components.Image: An image from a URL. A click opens it full-screen. Set description to say what the image shows, unless it is only decoration.
components.Icon: A Lucide icon by kebab-case name (for example "arrow-right"), or an A2UI icon name (for example "arrowBack"). Set label when no text next to the icon says what it means.
components.Svg: A vector drawing from primitive shapes (paths, circles, rects, lines, texts). Colors take text color tokens or CSS colors.
components.Video: A video file URL (optional captions) or a YouTube link, privacy-enhanced: the poster shows until play. Other video sites show as a link. Set title.
components.AudioPlayer: An audio player for an audio file URL, with the description above it.
components.HtmlView: Raw HTML in a fully sandboxed iframe: no scripts, no same-origin access. Set title to name the content.
components.FollowUp: Suggested next prompts as pills; a click sends the pill's message as the user's next turn, no event needed. At the end of a surface, two to four short items.
components.EntityCard: A card for one product, place, person or listing: image, title, subtitle, description, a price or meta line, badge, rating and up to three buttons. href opens a page; onClick is sent when bound. Use a Grid of them for several things.
components.ImageGrid: A gallery of images in a grid. A click opens the image full-screen, with arrows to the other images. layout "bento" makes the first image twice as large.
components.Breakdown: Amounts that add up to a total, such as a budget, a time plan or a split bill. The user changes each amount with its slider or by typing it. Each part has its own colour, a bar shows how the total splits, and the total updates as they edit. Use it instead of separate number fields and a total you compute.
